title: How to Set Up Blink Cloud in Cursor: 2-Minute Guide
summary: Add Blink's full-stack infrastructure to Cursor with one command: npx skills add [REDACTED]/blink-plugin. Get database, auth, and hosting connected to your AI agent in 2 minutes.
body_markdown: Blink has a free tier for exploration. Paid plans start at $25/month (Starter) and include database, auth, storage, backend, and hosting in one bill. This replaces Supabase ($25/mo) + Vercel ($20/mo) + Auth0 ($23/mo) — typically saving $50+ per month on the same stack. See[blink.new/cloud](https://blink.new/blog/%5BREDACTED%5D/cloud) for current pricing.
